title: Must Read
summary: Essential notices and basic server information to check before playing on the NEED server.

blocks.text: Must Read
Read this before you start playing on the NEED server. It covers the server rules, the CAPTCHA verification system, how to contact us and other basics.

blocks.title: Please read before you play
blocks.text: We cannot help with penalties caused by not knowing the rules. Please read these notices so that everyone can play in a pleasant and fair environment.
Quick Links
Server Rules
The basic rules every player must follow: no unauthorized programs, no bug abuse, no real-money trading, no abuse or slander, and more.
CAPTCHA Verification System
The CAPTCHA check that can appear while hunting to prevent abnormal play, the reward for passing it and what happens when you fail.
Basic Server Information

blocks.title: About the NEED Server
blocks.text: The NEED server aims for long-term operation and a wide range of content. Major notices are posted in the Discord announcements and the in-game wiki.
If you have a question, check the in-game wiki first. Key information on equipment, enchants, content, costumes, Lucky Eggs and more is added to the wiki step by step.

blocks.title: Using the In-Game Wiki
blocks.text: Open the NEED Wiki in game to read server guides and content information. Wiki pages may be updated and expanded with each update.
Notices and Changes
Server settings, rewards, events, balance and sanction criteria may change depending on the server situation. Important changes are announced in Discord or through wiki updates.

blocks.title: Check the notices regularly
blocks.text: Some systems, rewards and rules may change after an update, so check the Discord announcements and the wiki regularly.
Inquiries and Reports
For suspected unauthorized programs, bug reports, account inquiries and private inquiries that include personal information, use the Discord inquiry channel.

blocks.title: Use the Discord inquiry channel
blocks.text: Send reports and account inquiries through the Discord inquiry channel, not in a public channel. Including your character name, the time it happened, screenshots and the situation helps us check faster.
Discord Nickname
Your Discord nickname must match your in-game character name. It is used to confirm your identity for inquiries, reports, event entries and reward checks.

blocks.title: A server we build together
blocks.text: The NEED server keeps improving based on player reports and feedback. If something goes wrong, let us know through the Discord inquiry channel.
